# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **m155 platform readiness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 readies the m155 line with broader platform support and restored Linux font discovery. The release updates the core fork, adds Tizen 10 build and packaging support, and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Core fork cleanup integrated** — Brings the m155 Skia fork cleanup into the current line, keeping the bundled rendering engine aligned for the next release. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — Linux NoDependencies deployments can again discover system fonts without requiring bundled native dependencies. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 builds and packages supported** — Adds GCC 14.2 build and packaging coverage for Tizen 10, making native SkiaSharp assets available for the current Tizen platform. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Windows native build toolchain aligned** — Aligns Windows native builds with the v143 toolset and verifies the provenance of the bundled Spectre mitigations. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))
